mods.name: Nemeton Lantern (Item Glow)
mods.author: Nocturne
mods.description: Adds a razor-tight, painter's-order additive shimmer and subtle rim glow directly on 3D room pickups so hidden items stand out clearly in Nemeton Monastery. Press * in-game to toggle.

mods.name: Nemeton Tracker (Room, Turn & Durability HUD)
mods.author: Nocturne
mods.description: Koudelka exploration & battle companion HUD: live Room ID tracker, active battle turn banner, Level-Up callouts, and Weapon Durability at a Glance with configurable low-durability warnings.

mods.name: Chronicle Unleashed (All 6 Heroes + Bench EXP)
mods.author: Nocturne
mods.description: Unlocks all 6 Shadow Hearts (1913) party members early scaled to Yuri, plus live Bench EXP Share after every victory—now with independent live settings in F1 -> MODS.

mods.name: Crimson Flow (Judgment Ring Momentum)
mods.author: Nocturne
mods.description: Chain Perfect Judgment Ring strikes across SH1, SH2: Covenant & SH3: FTNW for escalating Cash, Bonus EXP, or Party HP Surges with a pinned Flow Streak HUD and persistent best-streak tracking.

mods.name: Party Vitals HUD (Gothic HP/MP Overlay)
mods.author: Nocturne
mods.description: Pure client-side Gothic 2D Canvas overlay displaying live party HP/MP bars and Levels across all 4 games. Configurable corner position, opacity, compact mode, and toggle hotkey.

mods.name: Nocturne QoL Suite (Recovery + Bench EXP + Sanctuary)
mods.author: Nocturne
mods.description: Configurable RPG Quality-of-Life suite for all 4 games: Post-Battle HP & MP recovery, cross-Quadrilogy Bench EXP Share, and optional Sanctuary Heal hotkey.

mods.name: Eclipse Challenge (Hardcore Judgment Ring Mode)
mods.author: Nocturne
mods.description: High-stakes Judgment Ring challenge for SH1, SH2 & SH3: missed Rings inflict configurable Cash Tax and Party HP Drain, while Perfect Strikes earn clutch bonus rewards.

mods.name: Director's Cut Dungeon Warp (QA Tester)
mods.author: Nocturne
mods.description: Safe Director's Cut test-warp utility for Shadow Hearts: Covenant. Pick a DC dungeon (Nahash, Cannes Boat, Deeper Neam Ruins, Sea of Woods, Dog Shrine, Ring Soul Quiz, or Debug Room) then choose NEW GAME on the Title Screen to boot straight into that map cleanly without touching your real saves.
